verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs confirm connectors automatically handle schema changes, type mapping, and load into destination tables ready for querying (fivetran-docs-18/24/33), with delete capture and sync modes (Soft Delete/Live/History) that manage row-level consistency (fivetran-docs-13, fivetran-docs-35), plus pre-built analytics-ready data models (fivetran-docs-25, fivetran-docs-57) rather than raw JSON dumps. Community feedback corroborates reliable, low-maintenance syncing (fivetran-comm-1, fivetran-comm-11) though it also notes occasional re-sync/consistency hiccups (fivetran-comm-10). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a 'deduplication' mechanism by name, and no independent technical audit confirming typed-table correctness at scale.
